scripts.lint: eslint src vite.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vitest.config.js --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,vue,css}" index.html vite.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html vite.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.format:check:all: prettier --check "src/**/*.{js,vue,css}" index.html vite.config.js eslint.config.js prettier.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check:all && npm run test:unit && npm run build
